name: Jaina must know

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Renn brings evidence of an unknown prisoner to Jaina.
description: Renn urges the investigator to report the manacles to Jaina without delay. The prisoner’s identity and fate are not established by the object itself; it only proves that a person was restrained. Theramore’s pale walls rise above the marsh and the sea, a place where the evidence can be weighed against the old report of Varian’s vanished voyage. Jaina now has a new clue, but still not the whole design.
